summary: MAX_REAL_SIGNATURES=1 was a process-local permit book. It prevented a second signature inside one invocation, but it did not prevent the operator from restarting the command, so each fresh process handed itself a fresh permit.
limitations: Based on sanitized operator execution evidence only.
No raw signature, SignedOperation, preimage, or credential was requested, produced, or persisted for this record.
Nonce counts and verification outcomes are as reported by the human operator; they are not re-derived from signer state.
This record is not Technocore server evidence and asserts nothing about any public or server-side state.
